# Cavryon

> Cavryon is an early-stage accounting intelligence company building AI-powered tools for SMB Controllers, Fractional CFOs, and Accounting Managers. Cavryon's core focus is catching general ledger (GL) issues — duplicate transactions, vendor miscoding, missing department coding, prepaid expense candidates, and unusual month-over-month account activity — before month-end close, without requiring any ERP integration.

Cavryon's positioning: "Is the close done — or is the close right?" Finding GL issues during month-end close typically takes hours of manual review; the corrections themselves usually take minutes. Cavryon is built to compress the investigation time, not just the correction time.

Cavryon works alongside existing accounting systems (QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, NetSuite, Xero, Sage Intacct) via a simple Excel GL export — no API access, no ERP credentials, and no IT setup required. Data is not stored beyond the user's session.

## Free Tools

- [Prepaid Expense Amortization Schedule Generator](https://www.cavryon.ai/tools/prepaid-schedule): A free, no-signup, browser-based tool that generates prepaid expense amortization schedules using mid-month convention (transactions starting on or before the 15th begin amortizing that month; on or after the 16th, the following month). Supports Excel/CSV upload with automatic column matching, a manual column-mapping fallback, and generates monthly journal entries by department.
- [Subscription Revenue Recognition Schedule Generator](https://www.cavryon.ai/tools/revenue-recognition): A free, no-signup, browser-based tool that generates subscription revenue recognition schedules under the same mid-month convention. Automatically handles mid-term subscription tier upgrades (e.g., a customer upgrading from a Basic to a Plus tier partway through a contract term), produces a deferred revenue rollforward, and generates the monthly journal entry (debit Deferred Revenue, credit Revenue by tier).

## Resources

- [Month-End Close Checklist](https://www.cavryon.ai/month-end-close-checklist): A practical month-end close checklist for Controllers and SMB finance teams.
- [Account Reconciliation Checklist](https://www.cavryon.ai/account-reconciliation-checklist): A checklist for reconciling cash, credit cards, AR, AP, payroll, prepaids, and balance sheet accounts.
- [GL Variance Analysis Guide](https://www.cavryon.ai/gl-variance-analysis-guide): A guide to investigating month-over-month general ledger account movement and duplicate postings.
- [Prepaid Expense Accounting Guide](https://www.cavryon.ai/prepaid-expense-accounting-guide): A guide to prepaid expense thresholds, schedules, amortization, and journal entries.
- [Book Cleanup Checklist](https://www.cavryon.ai/book-cleanup-checklist): A checklist for identifying stale balances, duplicate vendors, and uncategorized transactions.
- [Blog](https://www.cavryon.ai/blog): Articles on GL investigation, month-end close, prepaid accounting, vendor miscoding, and related SMB accounting topics.

## Company

- Cavryon is a pre-seed stage company (not yet publicly funded).
- Cavryon does not require any ERP integration — it works entirely from an Excel export of general ledger data.
- Cavryon's data handling architecture does not retain uploaded files beyond the active session.
